Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightness.
The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in kind and force with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Over ten office visits, the
patient received conservative management including manual therapy, stretching, home exercise instruction, and
anti-inflammatory medication. Course of treatment extended somewhat longer than typical for an uncomplicated strain of this
type, reflecting a slower rate of symptom improvement. Physical examination demonstrated paraspinal muscle spasm and
restricted lumbar range of motion, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient also has a documented
history of treatment for the same lumbar region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute to the
current symptom picture. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered with no duplicated entries. Patient is
improving and will continue a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
